tess: heads-up: found nondet precedence when combinator branches set the same override header. repro in yaml below.

 tess: repro YAML:
 ```
 - combinator: or
   rules:
     - id: branch-a
       match:
         path: /api/v1
         headers:
           X-Client: mobile
       overrides:
         headers:
           X-Route: mobile-v1
     - id: branch-b
       match:
         path: /api/v1
         headers:
           X-Client: web
       overrides:
         headers:
           X-Route: web-v1
 ```

 tess: expected X-Route to come from the matching branch. observed: preview merges header maps and runtime sometimes returns the other branch's value after restarts.

 kevin: can you curl it? which runtime? sounds like our flatten step loses branch boundaries.

 tess: curl example:
 ```
 curl -H "X-Client: mobile" "https://gw.example/api/v1" -I
 # sometimes X-Route: mobile-v1, sometimes web-v1
 ```

 tess: runtime version: dedicated v2.13.1, rolled kernels last week. added a failing unit for route-merge.

 marcos: we historically let branches share override keys to allow fallthrough defaults. but when we canonicalize to a single header map we introduce ambiguity. options:
 - (1) schema/lint: forbid duplicate header keys across branches (fast)
 - (2) runtime/preview: keep overrides attached to branch metadata and only apply the branch's overrides on match (bigger change)

 anya: Console preview is misleading now because it shows merged headers. if we keep (2) we should surface which branch produced each header (applied_by) in preview trace.

 kevin: i'm leaning to (1) with migration: block-by-default only after a cutoff date. add a lint rule with autofix suggestion: annotate conflicting keys with branch-scoped names or explicit precedence ordering.

 marcos: sketch of combinator validator: fail if intersection(headers.keys) > 0 across branches. we can implement as a preflight lint first rather than strict schema change.

 tess: agree. Console preflight lint that yields a yellow warning on save for existing configs, and an autofix that rewrites to explicit branch-scoped overrides. then block new configs after rollout.

 infra-bot: CI: routing-lint failed in pr #2489 - combinator-collisions.test (1/14)

 kevin: i'll pick up the linter PR and add unit tests for flattening and an integration check against dedicated:v2.13.1 to ensure deterministic behavior. i'll also add a small preview-trace ticket.

 anya: i'll mock the preview trace UI (applied_by badge per header) and attach screenshots to the PR.

 tess: plan: linter + tests -> feature-flagged preflight enforcement in Console -> preview trace UI -> decide permanent schema rule after telemetry. assigning @kevin @marcos. thanks.
